name: Reading Room
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Like reading a well-set book: a large serif on warm paper in brown ink, wide lines and generous paragraphs, bold in red, italics in blue and links in gold; a lamp-lit page after dark. Colours after Primary, our own CSS.

zh.description: 像在读一本排得很好的书：暖色纸上的大号衬线字，棕色墨迹，行距宽、段落舒展，粗体为红、斜体为蓝、链接为金；夜里是灯下的书页。配色参考 Primary，CSS 为我们自己编写。
